rows.en: One last way left?
For me… to serve Steel Emperor Zephas as the result of Atefarina's experiment.
The result of her experiment…?
[HERO4] and I are Atefarina's test subjects.
You can't mean…!? With those Vol cells?
Yes… I mean exactly that!
There's no other way to get the Dimensional Distortion Field lowered!
Shaider… I hear the Amigo Squad has been asked to sortie.
I see… So it's finally starting, the final battle…
Let's fight alongside them!
Yeah, of course! What about Commander Gavan and Sharivan?
Commander Gavan is in the M17 Omega Nebula, taking Kitz's place… and Sharivan is in combat on Planet Iga.
Contact them right away! Depending on how things are going there, they could join the fight on Earth…
OK!
[HERO2]… are you really going?

Yes…

More than that… Atefarina might turn me into a savage EATER!
Then let's think of another way after all!
That's right… Are you going to leave me all alone? That's breaking your promise…

[HERO4], please understand! Right now this is the only way!

Here, take this…
What's this?
Merry Christmas…

*sniffle*…

[HERO2], you liar! You meanie… stupid, stupid!! I don't want a Christmas present like this! What I want is…

What I want is…

[HERO2], you idiooot!!
[HERO2]!!
[HERO4]!!
I've been waiting for you! I knew you would come.

…!?

You knew?

…!?

You knew?

That's right!

And about your plan to send an assault team into our Space Fortress Naager and blow up the power reactor, too…
What's the matter! Why don't you say something?

Still, what a lot of trouble you've gone to…

I believe I told you before that it's impossible to get inside unless Atefarina opens the Dimensional Distortion Field.

You're one of my test subjects too!

Now, come along with me quietly! It's about time I put the finishing touches on the experiment… Prepare yourself!!
That's exactly what I intend to do…

What!?

My, my? What's gotten into you? Obeying so meekly!?
Do whatever you like with me as your test subject… You want it, don't you? This body of mine?
Go on, boil me or roast me. Do whatever you want…

I see, I've figured it out!

You'll get us to drop our guard by saying you'll undergo the final experiment, and then make me lift the Dimensional Distortion Field barrier, right?

Hah hah hah… I won't fall for that trick! Vortex… no, Vol-Textured Type!
That's right! [HERO2]'s planning to trick you. So you can't take him!
That's right! [HERO2]'s planning to trick you. So you can't take him!

What!?

Hmph… Velvet, is it? Perfect… The final experiment needs a male and a female EATER!

I'll take both of you creatures right here!

Don't be hasty, Atefarina! Didn't we prepare other male and female EATERs?

The Naager is ready for takeoff! There's no need to linger… We're returning to the ship, Atefarina!
Takeoff…? Don't tell me!? You've cultivated the Vol cells?
Heh heh heh… That's right, we've made plenty of them! Fruiting bodies, just like you…
You're going to do it all over again!? Make more sad test subjects like us…!

For our Battle Fleet Nation Naager… no, for Lord Steel Emperor Zephas, the Vol cells are everything!

A few sacrifices can't be helped…
A few sacrifices…?

Hmph… Atefarina! These two seem to be failures.

The hosts' emotions still remain! This vividly…

Because of what you call a few sacrifices… families were torn apart, and we lost any chance of living as human beings!

And you call that… a few sacrifices!?

Exactly! Lord Steel Emperor Zephas is the all-powerful, all-knowing being!

You still don't understand?

Then I'll teach you…

No matter how you struggle, no matter how you prattle on about your worthless justice… there are things you cannot do!

To be born into this world of your own will… and to attain immortality!

But… Lord Steel Emperor Zephas created you…

And yours is an immortal body, through genetic information passed on and repeated for eternity!

Well… are your eyes open now? Foolish humans… You are lower than insects.
You're one of those humans too, aren't you?
You're one of those humans too, aren't you?
Nngh, what nonsense…!
I won't forgive you! I'll never forgive you!! What do you think life is!

Oh, my… What a quick change of mood!

So you've finally shown your true colors? Vortex! I was going to use you for the final experiment… but it looks like you'll make good material for experiments on reviving Vol cells instead!

I told you, didn't I? The name "Battle Princess" isn't just for show!

I'll make sure you can never pull a cheeky farce like this again! Fusion Steel, equip!!

I'd rather say ignore him! But if you're going to fight, so be it…

Just don't waste any time! Hurry back to the ship! Understood?

Don't worry about me!

I'll teach him plenty about how Fusion Steel is superior even to Vol!
Bring it on! Here I come!

Kuh… Me!? Me, the one they even call the Battle Princess…

Ugh… My power… my power is fading!?
Atefarina…

Ugh…

Vortex…?
[HERO2]… it looks like Atefarina is trying to say something?
Huh…?

Excessive shock to the body's metal core…

It seems that's one way to escape the mental control of Fusion Steel… no, of the Vol cells…
What do you mean?
She's saying something about Fusion Steel…?
You two were my hope… my everything… Ugh…
Could it be… that Atefarina was an EATER too?
You mean the Vol cells died, and she went back to being a normal girl?

Ugh… I'm sorry to say, but I'm not an EATER… Of course, I am something close to one…

Vol cells… don't die off until they've completely taken over their host…

But… once they've fully assimilated it, they start moving in search of new eukaryotic cells… In other words, they look for another host…

As long as that keeps repeating, Vol reigns as an immortal being that never dies out…

What!?

Then… someday I'll attack some other person too!?

I'm sorry… That must be painful and sad for you, isn't it? But that's what Vol cells are…

No one can stop it…
Atefarina! You said you were different, didn't you? What… how are you different?

Fusion Steel…

The Fusion Steel I possess forms cell-mediated immunity against Vol cells…

What's more, it uses the Vol cells as an advanced adhesion factor to fuse the Fusion Steel, a prokaryotic cell, with the eukaryotic cells of higher animals…
So that… means, uh…
It means building immunity with Fusion Steel so you don't become a savage EATER… so the host keeps their sanity.
Then… if [HERO4] and I could just build up immunity with that Fusion Steel…
We could go on living like human beings?

I'm sorry…

that was the theme of the final experiment…

And besides… my Fusion Steel is… already… ugh…
